description: This file defines compile-time string formatting utilities for the fmt library, including classes, templates, and functions for efficient format string parsing and formatting at compile time.

classes.name: compiled_string
classes.description: A class representing a compile-time generated format string.

classes.name: udl_compiled_string
classes.description: A template struct for user-defined literal support for compile-time strings.

classes.name: text
classes.description: Represents a text segment in a format string.

classes.name: code_unit
classes.description: Represents a single character code unit in a format string.

classes.name: runtime_named_field
classes.description: A format field referring to an argument by name.

classes.name: spec_field
classes.description: A format field with specific formatting options.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first argument from a parameter pack.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the N-th argument from a parameter pack.

methods.name: get_arg_index_by_name
methods.description: Gets the index of an argument by its name.

methods.name: get_type_impl
methods.description: Helper template to get the type of the N-th argument.

methods.name: get_type
methods.description: Alias for get_type_impl to retrieve argument type.

methods.name: parse_tail
methods.description: Parses the tail of a format string.

methods.name: parse_specs
methods.description: Parses format specifications for an argument.

methods.name: compile_format_string
methods.description: Compiles a format string into a structured representation.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a format string at compile time.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats data according to a compiled format.

methods.name: format_to
methods.description: Formats data and writes to an output iterator.

methods.name: format_to_n
methods.description: Formats data into a buffer of specified size.

methods.name: formatted_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of formatted output.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a file or stdout.
